result.paraphrase: Want to upgrade from a SATA SSD? The SX6000 Lite PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 SSD is a strong choice. It supports NVMe 1.3, uses 3D NAND Flash, and offers up to 1TB capacity. Branded as “IT’S TIME TO UPGRADE WITH PCIe,” it’s presented as a fast, efficient, more productive alternative to SATA, suitable for desktops and notebooks. Featuring LDPC ECC for improved data integrity, plus HMB (Host Memory Buffer) and SLC caching, it delivers read/write speeds of up to 1800/1200MB/s and random performance of up to 220K/200K IOPS. Ideal for gamers, PC enthusiasts, and anyone moving from SATA SSD to PCIe SSD.
